name: animelist
description: An Obsidian plugin for managing anime, manga, and novel lists in Markdown.

scripts.test: node scripts/run-tests.mjs && node scripts/check-serial-reading-ui.mjs && node scripts/check-library-list-layout.mjs && node scripts/check-test-vault-fixtures.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run community:check && npm run build
scripts.test-vault: npm run check && npm run release:check && node scripts/test-vault.mjs production
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
